description: NaTi₈Bi₅O₂₆(BiO)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmmm space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two BiO sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction and two NaTi₈Bi₅O₂₆ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. In each BiO sheet, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. O is bonded to four equivalent Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OBi₄ tetrahedra. In each NaTi₈Bi₅O₂₆ sheet, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with eight equivalent BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.75 Å) and eight longer (2.82 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with five TiO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-22°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.22 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with five TiO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-22°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.22 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-1.96 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-1.96 Å. There are three inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.36 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with four equivalent BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra,  a faceface with one BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.62-2.76 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent BiO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight TiO₆ octahedra. There are eight shorter (2.68 Å) and four longer (2.75 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two Ti and four Bi atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two Ti and four Bi atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ti and two Bi atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Ti atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Ti atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, two Ti, and two Bi atoms.
